'''Rexy 360''' is a 360° reframing studio for camera operators. You drive a virtual remote head through your 360 footage with real wheels — pan, tilt, roll and zoom — shape the moves, cut them together and render.

Rexy 360 is designed for use with '''Rexy Wheels in joystick mode''', and can be operated with a '''gamepad''' too. NODO Inertia Wheels, OSC, MIDI, FreeD, mouse-signal hand wheels and the keyboard can drive it as well.

It is made by Real Pro Gear Ltd, designed by Robert Portazier, runs on Windows and macOS, and is '''free during the beta'''. The application is closed source.

== Start here ==
* [[Installing Rexy 360]] — download, the unsigned-installer warnings, macOS Input Monitoring.
* [[Rexy 360: Getting started|Getting started]] — open a clip, bind your wheels, record a move, render.

== What it does ==
* '''360 reframing''' — equirectangular (plus YouTube's cubemap and squashed 16:9, Insta360 .insv experimental), proxies for smooth scrubbing, renders from the full-resolution original. See [[Rexy 360: Importing footage|Importing footage]].
* '''A virtual remote head''' — Absolute or Continuous wheel modes, Horizon or Frame roll, Swoop, Unlimited tilt, soft stops, Autolevel, per-axis tuning. See [[Rexy 360: The virtual head|The virtual head]] and [[Rexy 360: Controllers and inputs|Controllers and inputs]].
* '''Lenses''' — a lens library of real zooms and primes, any frame shape (16:9, 9:16, 1:1 …) with guides, tiny-planet zoom. See [[Rexy 360: Lenses|Lenses]].
* '''Time''' — speed ramps 1 %–10 000 %, shutter-angle motion blur, light trails, slow motion by frame blending or optical flow. See [[Rexy 360: Time|Time]].
* '''Virtual motion control''' — record moves as takes, mark, anchor and reshape them; every take is a shot with its own In / Out and look. See [[Rexy 360: Recording moves|Recording moves]].
* '''Audio''' — music and sound tracks, sync to the clip's sound, and '''Audio → Move''': moves that pulse with the beat or follow the loudness. See [[Rexy 360: Audio and music|Audio and music]].
* '''Rexy Studio editing''' — projects and a library, an Edit timeline with overlays and blend modes, keyframes, dissolves, linked music. See [[Rexy 360: Editing|Editing]].
* '''Colour''' — a grade per shot and over the whole Edit, and .cube LUTs. See [[Rexy 360: Colour|Colour]].
* '''Import / export''' — files, Dropbox, Google Drive, YouTube (whole or a section); H.264, HEVC or ProRes. See [[Rexy 360: Rendering and export|Rendering and export]].

== Words used in Rexy 360 ==
; Clip : A 360° video you have imported.
; Shot : A recorded move (a take) on a clip, with its own In / Out and look.
; Shoot screen : The screen where you operate a clip and make shots.
; Edit : The timeline where shots are cut together and rendered as one film.
; Library : The right-hand panel listing a project's clips and shots.
